question: As of November 2026, who is the director of the U.S. Centers for Disease Control and Prevention (CDC)?
answer: As of November 2026, **Dr. Erica Schwartz** is the director of the U.S. Centers for Disease Control and Prevention (CDC) and administrator of the Agency for Toxic Substances and Disease Registry (ATSDR). [[1]]
